svg.title: The inverse of the local slot sampler in (PF8) is an inverse on truncated radial jets. The coefficient inverse required for a physical insertion is a different map. We construct it in the norms and units in which it is used. Fix a degree horizon d, its coherent frame, and a reporting level k ≥kd, where kd is the reference level for that frame. All assertions in this paragraph are uniform in N ≥k and the period p, with k fixed. Let Td,N,p be the calibrated terminal coefficient isomorphism of the insertion history.
